passages.text: Sam missed the first part of a group lesson about folding paper boxes. He asks Ella to explain the first fold before he tries to copy the finished box. She takes a fresh sheet and shows him how two edges meet in the middle. One bit of the paper is torn, so they turn the sheet and choose a different edge. Sam repeats the step slowly and tells Ella what he is doing. When the fold is ready, he can continue with the group instead of guessing from the final shape.

parallelText.en: Sam missed the first part of a group lesson about folding paper boxes.
parallelText.zh: 萨姆错过了小组课中折纸盒的第一部分。

parallelText.en: He asks Ella to explain the first fold before he tries to copy the finished box.
parallelText.zh: 他请埃拉先解释第一步折法，再尝试照着完成的纸盒做。

parallelText.en: She takes a fresh sheet and shows him how two edges meet in the middle.
parallelText.zh: 她拿一张新纸，示范两条边如何在中间对齐。

parallelText.en: One bit of the paper is torn, so they turn the sheet and choose a different edge.
parallelText.zh: 纸的一部分破了，于是他们转动纸张，选择另一条边。

parallelText.en: Sam repeats the step slowly and tells Ella what he is doing.
parallelText.zh: 萨姆慢慢重复这一步，并向埃拉讲述自己在做什么。

parallelText.en: When the fold is ready, he can continue with the group instead of guessing from the final shape.
parallelText.zh: 折好后，他就能跟上小组，而不必只凭最终形状猜做法。

passages.text: A wooden name board is loose outside the school garden. The pupils leave it on the ground and ask the caretaker to look at it. He finds a bent nail that no longer holds the board firmly in place. A single new nail is enough for this small repair, but he checks the wood before using it. The pupils watch from a safe distance and draw the repair in their garden notebook. After the board is fixed, they check that visitors can read the plant names clearly again.

parallelText.en: A wooden name board is loose outside the school garden.
parallelText.zh: 学校花园外的一块木制姓名牌松动了。

parallelText.en: The pupils leave it on the ground and ask the caretaker to look at it.
parallelText.zh: 学生们把它留在地上，请管理员查看。

parallelText.en: He finds a bent nail that no longer holds the board firmly in place.
parallelText.zh: 他发现一枚弯钉，已经不能牢牢固定木板。

parallelText.en: A single new nail is enough for this small repair, but he checks the wood before using it.
parallelText.zh: 这次小修理用一枚新钉就够，但他使用前先检查木头。

parallelText.en: The pupils watch from a safe distance and draw the repair in their garden notebook.
parallelText.zh: 学生们从安全距离观看，把修理过程画进花园笔记本。

parallelText.en: After the board is fixed, they check that visitors can read the plant names clearly again.
parallelText.zh: 木板固定后，他们确认参观者又能清楚读到植物名称。

wordHelp.meaning: a person who looks after a building
